title: Peter and Paul: just for unjust; made a curse
source_text: XI. Quo respiciens Petrus Apostolus dicit, Christum passum esse pro peccatis nostris, justum pro injustis; & ipsum peccata nostra pertulisse in corpore suo super lignum. Et Paulus, Christum factum esse pro nobis maledictum, quia scriptum est, Maledictus omnis qui pendet in ligno.
pass_a_gloss: Looking to this, the Apostle Peter says that Christ suffered for our sins, the just for the unjust, and that he himself bore our sins in his body on the tree. And Paul, that Christ was made a curse for us, because it is written, Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree.
pass_b_english: Peter: Christ suffered, the just for the unjust, bearing our sins on the tree.
Paul: made a curse for us—cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree.
